title: The setup rewind
statement: Let $c,C,q\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $x$ be a bit string. For every $j\le q$, after exactly $j+1$ steps of the unary box-enumeration machine from the configuration on input $x$ in the setup state, with every work tape containing $1^q$, every work head at position $j-1$, and empty output, it reaches the loop state at level $c$, with every work head at position $0$, the same tape contents, and empty output.
replaced: Let $c, C, q \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $x$ be a bit string. For every $j \le q$, running $\mathcal{P}_{c,C}$ for exactly $j+1$ steps from $\Gamma_q(\mathrm{setup}, h, \varepsilon)$, where every work head is at position $h(k) = j-1$, yields $\Gamma_q(\mathrm{loop}_c, h_0, \varepsilon)$, where every work head is at $h_0(k) = 0$; here $\mathcal{P}_{c,C}$ is the unary box-enumeration machine with $c+1$ work tapes, which writes $1^{|x|+1}$ on every work tape and then runs $c+1$ nested unary loops, emitting $C$ ones per innermost iteration, and $\mathrm{loop}_i$, $\mathrm{rewind}_i$, $\mathrm{advance}_i$, $\mathrm{emit}_j$ are its control states, setup is its rewinding state, and $\Gamma_q(s,h,o)$ denotes its configuration on input $x$ in control state $s$, with the input head on the blank cell right of the input, every work tape holding $1^q$ in cells $0,\dots,q-1$ and blanks elsewhere, work head $k$ at position $h(k)$, and output $o$.
